reading_structured.headline: The engine room and the structural engineer have opened a side door and are standing near it meaningfully.
omens: The offer expires quietly. Quiet expiry is the archive's least favorite sound.

reading_structured.aside: Sun in Cancer at 26.06°. Moon in Virgo at 22.95°. The archive closes at dusk, in principle. In practice the sky refuses to.
